name: Pad 6

Platform.Operating system: Android 13 based MIUI 14 upgradeable to Android 14 based Xiaomi HyperOS
Platform.Chipset: Qualcomm Snapdragon 870 (Pad 6), Qualcomm Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 (Pad 6 Pro, Pad 6 Max 14)
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x3.2 GHz Kryo 585 & 3x2.42 GHz Kryo 585 & 4x1.80 GHz Kryo 585)(Pad 6), Octa-core (1x3.19 GHz Cortex-X2 & 3x2.75 GHz Cortex-A710 & 4x1.80 GHz Cortex-A510)(Pad 6 Pro, Pad 6 Max 14)

Display.Display: Pad 6/Pro:IPS LCD, 1B colors, 144Hz, HDR10, Dolby Vision, 550 nits, 11.0 inches, 350.9 cm2 (~83.6% screen-to-body ratio), 1800 x 2880 pixels, 16:10 ratio (~309 ppi density), Corning Gorilla Glass 3, Pad 6 Max 14:IPS LCD, 1B colors, 120Hz, HDR10, Dolby Vision, 600 nits (peak), 14.0 inches, 573.0 cm2 (~87.3% screen-to-body ratio), 1800 x 2880 pixels, 16:10 ratio (~242 ppi density)

Cameras.Rear camera: Pad 6:13 MP, f/2.2, PDAF, Pad 6 Pro/Max 14: 50 MP, f/1.8, (wide), 1/2.76", 0.64µm, PDAF, 2 MP, f/2.4, (depth)

Battery.Charging: Xiaomi Pad 6: 33W MI Turbo Charge, Xiaomi Pad 6 Pro/Max 14: 67W Mi Turbo Charge

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/a/6, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth 5.2, USB Type-C 3.2, accessory connector, DisplayPort Out
